(E)‐(2‐Bromovinyl‐2′‐Deoxyuridine (E‐BVDU) was found to be the most active compound against cutaneous HSV infection.

all substances tested have shown a significant effect in reducing the virus titer in the infected skin, and the reduction was most marked with BVDU.

BVDU, KOP, and TPF have an inhibitory effect on the primary cutaneous HSV infection in guinea pig test models.
